title.zh: Multiple Polymarket Users Report Stolen Funds as Platform Restricts Trading and
title.en: Multiple Polymarket Users Report Stolen Funds as Platform Restricts Trading and

current_state.zh: Polymarket users reported unauthorized fund transfers and hundreds of thousands of dollars in losses, prompting the platform to enter cancel-only mode, halt relayer actions, and open an investigation into a suspected frontend compromise.
